Container.Name: manufactory-web
Container.Overview: Manufactory Idle web client (Caddy): serves the built client and proxies /api and /auth to manufactory-api. Plain HTTP; TLS ends at Cloudflare, whose tunnel reaches http://192.168.68.50:8087. Built locally by infra/unraid/deploy.sh; recreate it with deploy.sh --recreate.

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Host port for the cloudflared tunnel

Config.Name: CLIENT_IP_HEADER
Config.Description: Header carrying the player's IP (D-4); needs CLIENT_IP_TRUSTED_PROXIES too

Config.Name: CLIENT_IP_TRUSTED_PROXIES
Config.Description: Peers allowed to set CLIENT_IP_HEADER (cloudflared reaches us from a private address)
